baseline: Two accepted numbers, republished read-only beside this run's own measurement and neither re-decided: (1) the accepted counter-probe anchor falsifier run 39674402905 (results/evaluation/counter_probe_anchor_falsifier/39674402905.json, sha256 87c059f6c980fc000fa7151889a59f42900c33d6d29c4fd2391eec7010911048, EXPLORATORY, verdict COUNTER_PROBE_ANCHOR_FALSIFIED), whose per-bundle G4 de-redaction counterfactual is the accepted diagnosis of the probe-anchor bounded cause and whose product_handoff names remedy (a) — exclude the redaction placeholder from the probe key terms in product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py — as the recommended product fix; (2) the accepted minimal_ca_benchmark_v3 run 39680754374, whose mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates fail on de/fr/it of the V3 packet-of-record, the product-side symptom this remedy is meant to remove at the probe-construction layer. Neither accepted artefact verifies that the recommended remedy actually repairs the bounded cause; that verification is this run's question.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: whether the RECOMMENDED product remedy (a) — strip the redaction placeholder from the answer prose before the product's own probe planner — repairs the probe-anchor bounded cause on the pinned recorded bytes of the accepted 14-bundle population, under four frozen gates (G1 no placeholder token in any FIXED anchor; G2 topical FIXED anchor on every baseline-contaminated bundle; G3 byte-for-byte no-op on every clean-anchor bundle; G4 FIXED anchors equal the accepted record 39674402905's published G4 de-redacted anchors). It is a REPAIR VERIFICATION computed offline from committed bytes with zero network calls: the FIXED probes are never executed against OpenCaseLaw, so it is NOT a counter-authority recall measurement, NOT a live-retrieval measurement, NOT a label-emission measurement, NOT a measurement of the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates, NOT a claim about LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND (both stay REPORTED-ONLY), NOT a claim about jurist usefulness or the map, and NOT a serve recommendation. It lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; packet admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready and owner_decision_required stay false. It does NOT authorise the product lane to skip re-measuring after it lands the fix: when the product bytes change, this freeze's product pins drift and a NEW freeze under a NEW run id must verify the shipped planner itself. No universal-174k benchmark is run and no product source file is modified by this instrument.
controls: C1_baseline_reproduces_recorded_probes — the BASELINE arm (the product's own plan_adversarial_queries on the bundle's own recorded answer prose) reproduces every recorded probe query byte-for-byte, so the measurement is faithful to the shipped behaviour. A failure means the baseline arm is unfaithful and the run is not a repair verdict (exit 2).

C2_blank_prose_yields_no_plan_in_both_arms — after the remedy, a prose consisting only of the redaction placeholder yields NO probe plan (the product's D4 vacuity guard is restored for placeholder-only prose), and a blank prose yields none in the BASELINE arm.
C3_repair_target_exists — at least one measured bundle has a BASELINE placeholder-contaminated anchor, so the repair target still exists on the pinned bytes (non-vacuity of the defect under repair).

C4_fix_is_noop_without_the_placeholder — for every bundle whose answer prose contains no redaction placeholder, the FIXED arm is a byte-for-byte no-op: the shim's own placebo arm, so the attribution of any change to the placeholder cannot be an artefact of the shim.

C5_fix_does_not_kill_probe_emission — every bundle whose BASELINE arm emitted at least one probe plan still emits at least one under the FIXED arm: the remedy must remove contamination, not probe emission.

exit_code_contract.0: REPAIR_VERIFIED_ON_RECORDED_BYTES — the measurable population is non-empty, all pins held, all five controls passed, and all four gates passed: on the pinned recorded bytes the recommended remedy (a) repairs the probe-anchor bounded cause
exit_code_contract.1: REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT_ON_RECORDED_BYTES — at least one of gates G1-G4 failed while all five controls and all pins held: remedy (a) as specified would NOT fully repair the bounded cause on these bytes
exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS — a pin drifted before or after execution (if a product pin drifted, the shipped behaviour has changed since the accepted measurement and the run must be re-frozen under a new run id), a non-vacuity control failed, the measurable population was empty, or no accepted-record row was comparable for G4; never a product verdict

freeze_history.note: RE-FREEZE after a CONTROL-IMPLEMENTATION bug in the first claim-bearing run (attempt 1, preserved verbatim at results/evaluation/counter_probe_repair_verification/39687372110_attempt1_c4_implementation_bug.json sha256 967bfd52a42caf7779a9023a77d3a7b8c2762b201cfe43aa2757dc5f94d7d60c): control C4 was implemented as `C4_placeholder_absent_noop is not True`, which counted the six ph>0 bundles' not-applicable None values as placebo failures and forced verdict ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS. The FROZEN control definition in this hypothesis ('for every bundle whose answer prose contains no redaction placeholder') was always correct; only the code diverged from it. The fix changes ONLY that predicate to `is False`. The frozen rule, the four gates, the five control definitions, the exit codes, the population, the thresholds (none) and the claim ceiling are byte-identical. The gate outcomes of attempt 1 (G1-G4 all PASS) are reported as observed but are NOT a verdict (attempt 1 was ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS, never a product verdict); the re-run's outcomes are the run's verdict. Both digests were re-frozen before the corrected claim-bearing execution.

frozen_rule: per bundle with recorded adversarial probes: BASELINE arm = product.plan_adversarial_queries(query, prose); FIXED arm = product.plan_adversarial_queries(query, prose with every REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER occurrence replaced by a space), i.e. the evaluation-side emulation of the recommended product remedy (a). Gates: G1 holds iff every FIXED anchor (first ANCHOR_SLOTS whitespace tokens of the first FIXED probe query) contains no token of the product's own answer_key_terms(REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER); G2 holds iff on every bundle whose BASELINE anchor is contaminated the FIXED anchor shares at least one question content term under the product's own pool rule (len >= 6, not in _ANSWER_STOP, not a digit); G3 holds iff on every bundle whose BASELINE anchor is NOT contaminated the FIXED arm issues byte-for-byte the same probe query list as the BASELINE arm; G4 holds iff on every bundle whose row exists in the accepted record 39674402905 the FIXED anchor equals that record's published G4_counterfactual.de_redacted_anchor byte-for-byte. The run verdict is REPAIR_VERIFIED_ON_RECORDED_BYTES iff all four gates and all five controls pass and all pins hold; REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT_ON_RECORDED_BYTES iff at least one gate fails while all controls and pins hold; ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS iff any control fails, any pin drifts before or after execution, the population is empty, or zero accepted-record rows are G4-comparable. All comparisons are set/list equality on the product's own tokenisation: there is NO count, rate, frequency, share or percentage threshold anywhere in the rule, and none may be introduced after the result is seen.
hypothesis: For every bundle of the accepted 14-bundle product population that issued a recorded counter-authority probe, applying the recommended product remedy (a) — stripping the generative audit's redaction placeholder '[citation removed: not in retrieved set]' from the answer prose before the product's own probe planner — repairs the probe-anchor bounded cause: every issued probe's topic anchor becomes free of placeholder-derived tokens (G1); on the two German bundles whose shipped anchors were contaminated (packets 39275520116 and 39319405429) the repaired anchor regains at least one content term of the question it is supposed to attack (G2); on the twelve bundles whose shipped anchors were not contaminated the repair is a byte-for-byte no-op, so working probes are not perturbed (G3); and every repaired anchor equals, byte-for-byte, the de-redacted anchor the accepted falsifier 39674402905 already published, so two separately committed computations of the remedy agree (G4). FALSIFIED (verdict REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT_ON_RECORDED_BYTES) iff any gate fails while all controls hold. The claim under test is a product-repair claim: the counter-authority channel must attack the legal proposition of its question, and the product lane's handoff names remedy (a) as sufficient; this run tests that sufficiency on the recorded bytes before the product lane spends a cycle landing it.
metric: Per bundle with recorded adversarial probes: (i) the BASELINE anchor and probe query list, computed by the product's own plan_adversarial_queries from the bundle's own recorded answer prose (faithfulness gated by C1 against the recorded probes); (ii) the FIXED anchor and probe query list, computed by the same product function from the prose with every REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER occurrence replaced by a space (the evaluation-side emulation of remedy (a)); (iii) gate observables G1 = FIXED anchor intersect answer_key_terms(REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER), G2 = FIXED anchor intersect question content terms on baseline-contaminated bundles, G3 = list equality FIXED queries vs BASELINE queries on clean-anchor bundles, G4 = FIXED anchor vs the accepted record's published de-redacted anchor; (iv) REPORTED-ONLY, no threshold: the exact per-intent probe query diff between the two arms, published as the product lane's acceptance fixture. Every number is reported with its denominator; no rate is thresholded.
no_thresholds_statement: Every gate is set intersection or byte-for-byte list/string equality on the product's own tokenisation, the product's own stoplist and the product's own placeholder constant. No bar, rubric, threshold, share, ratio, count cut-off, stoplist, tokeniser, projection constant or verdict contract of any frozen suite is read for enforcement, edited, re-derived, re-tuned or paraphrased. RULES_LABEL.json / RULES_GEOMETRY.json / VERDICT_CONTRACT.json are not inputs to this instrument. The probe-query diff is REPORTED-ONLY and can never change the verdict. The product's own answer_key_terms, plan_adversarial_queries, _ANSWER_STOP, tokenize and REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER are used as-is from the pinned mount via the accepted falsifier's own loader and are never re-implemented here.

The committed secondary source results/evaluation/rebuilt_packet_adjudication_39049030442/packet/ (manifest 66e2a07e3bc8397921241dbba71c5babd74de5d0480f20316785e97bb814ab8c, 3 bundles) is the documented mount-absent fallback. The population is a function of the source tree, not a hand-picked list.

product_handoff: If the verdict is REPAIR_VERIFIED_ON_RECORDED_BYTES, remedy (a) is verified sufficient on the recorded bytes and the product lane may land it in product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py (strip REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER from the prose before answer_key_terms, or exclude the placeholder's tokens from the candidate set); after landing, the product lane must re-run its own bundle production and the evaluation lane will re-freeze this verification against the NEW product bytes (the present freeze's product pins will drift by design, which is the fail-closed signal that the shipped behaviour changed). The per-bundle probe_query_diff published in the result is the acceptance fixture: the shipped planner, after the fix, should issue those exact probe queries on those exact bundles. If the verdict is REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT_ON_RECORDED_BYTES, remedy (a) as specified is NOT sufficient on these bytes and the product lane must not treat it as the fix; the failed gate names what is missing. Either way this instrument ends at the repair contract; the product lane owns the code change, and this lane's write scope forbids touching product source.
